Signed in · your lists stay in step with TMDB
TMDB is a free film and TV database. Sign in once with your phone and My list, Seen and Favorites stay in step with your account.
Skip it and your lists are kept on this TV only. You can sign in later from Launcher settings.
What does the household pay for?
Titles on these services show as Included in Movies and TV Shows. The ones with an app on this TV were ticked to start with.
OK opens the same page as Launcher settings › Streaming services.
Where may we show prices from?
Rent and buy prices in kronor come from these stores, the cheapest first.
OK opens the same page as Launcher settings › Stores for rent and buy.
Home shows today’s and tomorrow’s weather, and an hourly strip below the apps. The city starts as the build’s default.
